_comment: buddy-scheduler JSON output schema. Emitted to stdout on every execution path.

_always_present.success: boolean — true if a valid pairing was produced
_always_present.pairs: array of [string, string] — member pairs; empty on failure; each pair sorted lexicographically; outer list sorted
_always_present.sitting_out: string|null — name of sit-out member (odd active count); null otherwise
_always_present.optimization_score: number — total weighted penalty; 0.0 on failure
_always_present.solve_time: number — wall-clock seconds for the MIP solve
_always_present.solver_profile: string — resolved profile name: "fast", "balanced", or "optimal" ("adaptive" resolves to one of these three)
_always_present.history_updated: boolean — true if history store was written this run

_conditionally_present.solver_gap: number — achieved MIP optimality gap fraction; present only when reported by solver
_conditionally_present.peak_memory_mb: number — peak process RSS in MB; present when memory tracking available
_conditionally_present.memory_delta_mb: number — memory increase from start to end; present when memory tracking available
_conditionally_present.inactive_members: array of string — names of inactive members excluded from pairing; omitted when empty
_conditionally_present.avoidance_conflicts: array of string — human-readable conflict descriptions; present only when success=false due to infeasible avoidance constraints
_conditionally_present.error: string — human-readable error message; present only on failure

avoidance_conflicts: Alice has no eligible pairing partners
failure_infeasible.error: Infeasible: avoidance constraints prevent a valid pairing.
